# rind-ui

> Headless React components: behaviour, accessibility and state, styled through data-* attributes.

## Guides

- [Announcements](docs/guides/announcements.md): Some changes have no focus move to carry them — "3 results", "Copied", a streamed answer. Components announce them through the environment's `Announcer`; they never render their own live region.
- [Autosize](docs/guides/autosize.md): A textarea that takes the height of its content, used by Text Field's `autosize` and later by Prompt Input and Editable. Native first, measured only where the browser cannot do it.
- [Collections](docs/guides/collections.md): Listbox, Select, Combobox, Menu, Tabs, Tree View and every other component that shows a set of items share one collection layer in `@rind-ui/core`: a key-based model of the items, selection, navigation, typeahead and the props of the collection parts. A component spreads these pieces into its machine; it never re-implements them.
- [control-label](docs/guides/control-label.md): The shared Label and Description of a labelable control (Checkbox, Switch, group items, radios).
- [Implementing field-control](docs/guides/field-control.md): How a form control works inside a Field. Every rind-ui form control (Text Field, Checkbox, Select, …) does this, and your own control can too: the Field then labels, describes, validates and disables it like a built-in one.
- [Focus and input modality](docs/guides/focus-and-modality.md): Every focusable part carries `data-focus` while focused and `data-focus-visible` only when the focus came from the keyboard or from assistive technology, so a theme draws the focus ring for keyboard and screen-reader users and never after a mouse click.
- [hidden-form-input](docs/guides/hidden-form-input.md): The shared behaviour that lets a control that is not a native form field (Checkbox, Switch, [Checkbox Group](../components/checkbox-group.md), [Radio Group](../components/radio-group.md), later Select) take part in forms. Each control renders one visually hidden native input as the last child of its Root, `aria-hidden` and out of the Tab order.
- [Collapsed content that find-in-page can reach](docs/guides/hidden-until-found.md): Collapsible content can render closed as `hidden="until-found"`: hidden from view and from assistive technology, but the browser's find-in-page (and fragment links) can still match it. When a match is found the browser fires `beforematch`; the component opens with reason `find-in-page` and marks the content `data-reveal="find-in-page"`.
- [Keyboard, composition and right-to-left](docs/guides/keyboard-and-rtl.md): Components read keys as **logical keys** — `NEXT`, `PREV`, `FIRST`, `LAST`, `PAGE_NEXT`, `PAGE_PREV`, `EXPAND`, `COLLAPSE`, `INCREASE`, `DECREASE`, `ACTIVATE`, `DISMISS`, `CONTEXT_MENU` — so direction, orientation and platform are handled once.
- [Labels](docs/guides/labels.md): Every rind-ui label follows the same rules, whether it is the standalone [Label](../components/label.md), a control's own Label part (Checkbox, Switch) or a Field's Label. The browser's native `<label>` does the naming and the activation; rind-ui only adds what native labels get wrong.
- [Messages, locale and RindProvider](docs/guides/messages-and-provider.md): Every user-visible string a component owns (labels it generates, hints, announcements) is a typed **message** with an English default, overridable per component or for a whole tree. Numbers, plurals, sorting and sentence splitting use `Intl` with the component's locale (`format.number`, `plural`, `format.collator`, `format.segmenter`; instances are cached).
- [number-parsing](docs/guides/number-parsing.md): The shared capability that turns text a user types or pastes into a number and back, for a locale and `Intl.NumberFormat` options. Used by [Number Input](../components/number-input.md); later numeric fields reuse it. It wraps `@internationalized/number` and adds what that lacks: Persian digits, group separators and literal prefixes in partial input, no silent rounding, and value text for assistive technology.
- [Overlays](docs/guides/overlays.md): Dialogs, popovers, menus and drawers share one layer stack per document that decides who is on top, what dismisses what, where focus goes, what is inert and whether the page scrolls; a component only registers its layer.
- [Positioning](docs/guides/positioning.md): Popover, Menu, Select, Combobox, Tooltip and every other popup anchored to something share one positioning capability in `@rind-ui/core` (`dom/position`, built on `@floating-ui/dom`). A machine tracks its popup only through `env.position`, from an effect scoped to its open state; coordinates and sizes go straight to CSS custom properties and only the discrete results (side, align, anchor hidden, first placement) come back as a `POSITION.PLACED` event.
- [Press, hover and long press](docs/guides/press-and-hover.md): `usePress` (React) / `createPress` (core) turn pointer, mouse, keyboard and screen-reader input into one stream of machine events, so a part activates the same way however it is used: `PRESS.START`, `PRESS.UP`, `PRESS.END`, `PRESS`, `PRESS.CANCEL`, plus `LONG_PRESS` and `CONTEXT_MENU` when enabled.
- [Testing accessibility](docs/guides/testing-accessibility.md): `@rind-ui/testing` checks accessibility as part of every model-based test, not as a separate suite.
- [VisuallyHidden](docs/guides/visually-hidden.md): Content read by assistive technology but not shown — never `display: none` or `visibility: hidden`, which also hide it from screen readers.
- [White-label theming](docs/theme/white-label.md): rind-ui is themed with CSS custom properties in three tiers, scoped by the `data-rind-theme` attribute. One brand colour re-skins every component, light and dark, and a multi-tenant page can show several brands side by side. Token names: [tokens.md](tokens.md). Building validated themes: [builder.md](builder.md).
- [Theme builder](docs/theme/builder.md): `@rind-ui/theme/builder` turns brand inputs into validated theme CSS. It is pure TypeScript with no DOM and no dependency, so it runs in a build script, a server request or a browser. The same input always gives the same bytes.
- [Token reference](docs/theme/tokens.md): Every tier 2 (semantic) token and every component's tier 3 token. Tier 1 are the twelve `--rind-brand-*` inputs; see [white-label.md](white-label.md).

## Components

- [Accordion](docs/components/accordion.md): A set of headers, each toggling one panel. Every item is a [Collapsible](collapsible.md), so closed panels stay findable by the browser's search (`closedContent="until-found"`, the default).
- [Alert Dialog](docs/components/alert-dialog.md): A modal dialog that asks the user to confirm or cancel a consequential action. It is the [Dialog](dialog.md) with stricter rules: always modal, `role="alertdialog"`, focus starts on Cancel, and only Escape, Cancel or an action closes it. Everything else (open state and reasons, nesting, forms, mounting, final focus) behaves as the Dialog does; both are built from the same machine.
- [Aspect Ratio](docs/components/aspect-ratio.md): There is no `AspectRatio` component to import: put the native CSS `aspect-ratio` property on the element itself (`<div style={{ aspectRatio: "16 / 9" }}>`), with no wrapper. This page is the recipe that replaces an `AspectRatio` component.
- [Avatar](docs/components/avatar.md): A person or an entity shown as an image, with a fallback (initials, an icon) while the image is missing, loading or broken. The avatar has one accessible name in every status, and the rendered `<img>` is the only thing that loads the image.
- [Badge](docs/components/badge.md): A small piece of static status text: a count, a label, a dot. It is never interactive and never a live region; its meaning reaches assistive technology through the control it sits on.
- [Breadcrumbs](docs/components/breadcrumbs.md): A navigation landmark with the trail of links to the ancestors of the current location. The current item is explicit, separators are hidden glyphs, and long trails can collapse their middle items into a menu you render.
- [Button](docs/components/button.md): A button that reports each activation once, from every input (mouse, touch, Enter, Space, a screen reader's click), with its modality; a pending state that keeps focus and announces itself; and the same behaviour whatever element it renders.
- [Checkbox Group](docs/components/checkbox-group.md): A set of [Checkboxes](checkbox.md) that share one array value, with an optional select-all `Parent`. The Root is a `role="group"` named by its Label (a native `<fieldset>`/`<legend>` through `render` needs no role); each item is a Checkbox with its own hidden native input ([hidden-form-input](../guides/hidden-form-input.md)).
- [Checkbox](docs/components/checkbox.md): A checked, unchecked or mixed (`indeterminate`) choice that is submitted with a form. The Control is a real `<button role="checkbox">`; a hidden native `<input type="checkbox">` carries the value, validation and reset ([hidden-form-input](../guides/hidden-form-input.md)).
- [Collapsible](docs/components/collapsible.md): A trigger that shows and hides one region. Closed content stays findable by the browser's search (`closedContent="until-found"`, the default), or is hidden, or is removed.
- [Dialog](docs/components/dialog.md): A window layered over the page. It is modal by default: everything outside is inert, the page does not scroll and Tab stays inside. Focus moves in on open and returns to the opener on close. The content is `role="dialog"`, named by its title.
- [Field](docs/components/field.md): Gives one form control a label, a description and an error message, carries `disabled`, `readOnly`, `required` and `invalid` to it, validates it, and exposes the result as data attributes, ARIA and a driver.
- [Fieldset](docs/components/fieldset.md): A native `<fieldset>` that names and describes a group of related controls, shows a group-level error, and disables every control inside it, native and rind-ui alike, portalled parts included.
- [Form](docs/components/form.md): A native `<form>` that validates every Field it contains on a submit attempt, focuses the first invalid one, holds a submission for pending async checks, maps server errors to Fields by name, announces a failed attempt once, and resets with rules that survive React form actions.
- [Heading](docs/components/heading.md): A heading whose level comes from where it is: sections nest, and each `Heading` renders the native `h1`–`h6` for its depth, so the document outline stays right without counting levels by hand.
- [Label](docs/components/label.md): A native `<label>` that names a control through `for` or by wrapping it, and fixes what native labels get wrong: no text selection on double click, focus forwarding for controls a label cannot name, and a development check of what `for` points at.
- [Link](docs/components/link.md): A navigational link that behaves like a native `<a href>` wherever it appears: client routing without double navigation, modifier clicks left to the browser, disabled and current states, and a driver to test it.
- [Menu](docs/components/menu.md): A list of actions opened from a trigger button: `role="menu"` with items, checkbox and radio items, groups, links and nested submenus. It is modal by default (the page behind is inert); `modal={false}` leaves it usable. The content is positioned against the trigger by the shared positioning capability and named by the trigger.
- [Number Input](docs/components/number-input.md): A text field for numbers with an optional stepper on each side. It formats and parses in the user's locale (decimal, percent, currency, unit; Latin, Arabic, Persian, Devanagari and full-width digits), steps by keyboard, buttons, press-and-hold and wheel, and submits a real number through a hidden native `<input type="number">`. The Root is a Field, so labelling, description and validation work like any Field.
- [Pagination](docs/components/pagination.md): Navigation between the pages of a long list: a `nav` landmark with the page controls, Previous and Next, and optionally First and Last. The controls are buttons, or links when each page has a URL.
- [Password Input](docs/components/password-input.md): A [Text Field](text-field.md) for secrets with a visibility toggle that every input method can operate. The toggle keeps one name, keeps the caret where the user left it, and the password is hidden again on every form submit and reset. Value, IME handling and Field integration are Text Field's.
- [Pin Input](docs/components/pin-input.md): A fixed-length code (verification code, PIN) entered in **one native text input** drawn over presentational slots. Typing, paste, SMS and password-manager autofill, IME and screen readers all work as they do for one ordinary field. The Root is a Field, so labelling, description and validation work like any Field.
- [Popover](docs/components/popover.md): A floating panel anchored to a trigger. It is non-modal by default: the page stays usable, a press or focus outside closes it, and Tab continues from the trigger into the content. The content is `role="dialog"`, positioned against the trigger (or an `Anchor`) by the shared positioning capability.
- [QR Code](docs/components/qr-code.md): A value rendered as a scannable QR Code symbol: a named image whose description is the value, an optional logo, and a download trigger. Encoding is done by rind-ui's own encoder, with no dependency; the symbol is identical on the server and in the browser.
- [Radio Group](docs/components/radio-group.md): One choice out of several. The Root is a `role="radiogroup"` named by its Label; each Item has a real `<button role="radio">` control and a hidden native `<input type="radio">` that carries the value, validation and reset ([hidden-form-input](../guides/hidden-form-input.md)). Arrow keys move focus **and** check, as the native radio group does.
- [Scroll Area](docs/components/scroll-area.md): A native scroll container whose scrollbars are drawn by you. The browser keeps doing all the scrolling: wheel, touch, momentum, keyboard, zoom, find-in-page, right-to-left and forced colors work as in any `overflow: auto` element. The component hides the native bars, measures, and draws a thumb you can drag.
- [Search Field](docs/components/search-field.md): A [Text Field](text-field.md) with search semantics: a `searchbox` input, Escape to clear, Enter to search, and one clear control. It never breaks IME input and never steals Escape from an enclosing Dialog when there is nothing to clear.
- [Segmented Control](docs/components/segmented-control.md): One choice out of a joined strip of segments. It is a radio group under its own scope: the root is a `role="radiogroup"`, each segment a real `<button role="radio">` with an explicit `aria-checked`, and one hidden `<input type="radio">` per segment submits the value with a form. The value is the selected segment's key (`string | null`).
- [Separator](docs/components/separator.md): A static divider between groups of content or controls. It is never focusable and has no state; the same rules decide the role and orientation of every divider in rind-ui (Toolbar, Menu, the listbox popups).
- [Skeleton](docs/components/skeleton.md): Placeholder shapes for content that is still loading. The loading state is exposed once for the whole area: the region is busy, the placeholders are hidden from assistive technology and unreachable by Tab, a visually hidden "Loading" text sits outside the region, and the shimmer stops for users who prefer reduced motion.
- [Slider](docs/components/slider.md): Selects one value, or several (a range), on a continuous axis (APG Slider and Multi-Thumb Slider). Every thumb is backed by a real `<input type="range">`, the only focusable element of the thumb: browsers, screen readers and forms treat it as a native slider ([hidden-form-input](../guides/hidden-form-input.md)).
- [Switch](docs/components/switch.md): An on/off setting that takes effect immediately (APG Switch). The Control is a real `<button role="switch">`; a hidden native `<input type="checkbox">` carries the value, validation and reset ([hidden-form-input](../guides/hidden-form-input.md)).
- [Tabs](docs/components/tabs.md): A tab list with one roving tab stop and one panel per tab. Tabs are real `<button role="tab">` elements with an always explicit `aria-selected`; panels are `role="tabpanel"` labelled by their tab. The value is the selected tab's key (`string | null`).
- [Text Field](docs/components/text-field.md): A native `<input>` or `<textarea>` with a controllable value, correct IME handling, a clear button, a character count and autosize, labelled, described and validated like any Field.
- [Toggle Group](docs/components/toggle-group.md): A set of [Toggles](toggle.md) that share one roving tab stop and one value. Each Item is a real `<button aria-pressed>`; the group is a `role="group"` named by you. `selectionMode` is `single` (pressing an item replaces the selection, the default) or `multiple`. The value is always a `string[]`.
- [Toggle](docs/components/toggle.md): A two-state button: it is on or off, and says so with `aria-pressed`. Use it for a setting that applies immediately (Bold, Mute, Pin).
- [Toolbar](docs/components/toolbar.md): A row (or column) of controls with one roving tab stop. Tab enters the toolbar on the last control that had focus, arrows move between controls, Tab leaves. The root is `role="toolbar"` named by you; its controls keep their own roles: buttons, links, the items of a hosted [Toggle Group](toggle-group.md) or [Radio Group](radio-group.md), and any other control through `Toolbar.Item`.
- [Tooltip](docs/components/tooltip.md): A short text shown when the pointer rests on a trigger or the trigger receives keyboard focus. It supplements the trigger; it is not a place for anything interactive. The content is `role="tooltip"`, never focusable, positioned against the trigger by the shared positioning capability.

## Accessibility

- [Support matrix](docs/accessibility/support-matrix.md): which screen reader and browser combinations are supported, and how each is tested.
- [Quirks](docs/accessibility/quirks.md): every browser and assistive-technology workaround, with its bug links.
